statement: Acceptance obligations: Public persistence APIs permit overlapping calls with stable caller-owned inputs. / A process-wide recursive mutex guards region read/merge/write, metadata pairs, shared durable writes and empty-record cleanup. / It serializes writers through reclamation and replacement; / nested calls retain ownership until the outer call returns. / Independently launched processes sharing one save directory are outside this ownership contract. / Incoming pairs are validated before either replacement.
